input.quote: 13.5 No Other Warranties. EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY STATED IN THIS ARTICLE XIII, (A) NO REPRESENTATION, CONDITION OR WARRANTY WHATSOEVER IS MADE OR GIVEN BY OR ON BEHALF OF SANOFI OR REVMED; AND (B) ALL OTHER CONDITIONS AND WARRANTIES WHETHER WRITTEN OR ORAL OR EXPRESS OR IMPLIED ARE HEREBY EXPRESSLY EXCLUDED, INCLUDING ANY CONDITIONS AND WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE OR NON-INFRINGEMENT.
input.rationale: Article XIII contains no performance warranty running to us. Section 13.1 covers organisation/authority, Section 13.2 gives IP, title and litigation reps expressly limited to "as of the Execution Date", and Sections 13.3-13.4 are forward-looking covenants (no debarment, compliance with Applicable Law, pharmacovigilance information). Nothing warrants that RevMed's Research, Development or Manufacturing activities or anything delivered to us will conform to the applicable plan or documentation, and there is no repair/replacement or refund remedy anywhere in the document (searches for software, conformance and refund remedies return nothing on point). Section 13.5 then disclaims all other express and implied warranties, so the agreement fails even the fallback (90-day software conformance, 30-day services, repair/replace and refund). We therefore insert the shortest fallback-level warranty at the fallback thresholds; because Section 13.5 excepts warranties "EXPRESSLY STATED IN THIS ARTICLE XIII", the new Section 13.4A survives the disclaimer and no carve-out edit is needed. Section 13.4(b)'s compliance covenant and the knowledge-qualified compliance rep in 13.2(u) are noted but are not conformance warranties.

proposal.summary: Insert an express RevMed performance warranty (software-to-documentation 90 days; services 30 days) with repair/replacement and refund remedies.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article XIII contains only Execution-Date IP and title reps plus a broad disclaimer, so we have no performance warranty for RevMed's activities or deliverables. We have added a short fallback-level warranty (90 days software-to-documentation, 30 days services) with repair/replacement or refund; the existing Section 13.5 disclaimer already preserves warranties expressly stated in this Article XIII.

ops.text: Performance Warranty. RevMed warrants that (a) for ninety (90) days following delivery, any software delivered by RevMed to Sanofi under this Agreement will conform in all material respects to its documentation, and (b) for thirty (30) days following performance, the Research, Development, Manufacturing and other services performed by RevMed under this Agreement will conform in all material respects to the requirements of this Agreement and the applicable plan. For breach of this warranty, RevMed shall, at Sanofi's election, repair, replace or re-perform the non-conforming software or services, or refund the amounts paid for them.

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
